rules.contract: Mapped ordinary text is default-visible modelspace TEXT/MTEXT with the supplied expected string.
rules.abstain: No target mapping; never infer correct transcription from entity type.

rules.contract: Exact packaged LFF ink AABB stays within supplied axis-aligned cell. Positive TEXT height/width; only 0/90/180/270-degree, left-baseline placement.
rules.abstain: Unknown cell, font, glyph, MTEXT, arbitrary angle, alignment, oblique or generation flags. No national standard font size asserted.

rules.contract: Every source-outline handle in the caller-attested complete ownership mapping is removed or default hidden after replacement.
rules.abstain: Incomplete ownership proof, empty or missing source members. Does not prove absence of unmapped/re-created strokes.

rules.contract: Mapped background has independent handles; entity and resolved layer/style/linetype/unit fingerprints stay identical.
rules.abstain: Missing mapping or unresolved BLOCK/IMAGE/HATCH dependencies. Role is supplied evidence, not automatic logo detection.

rules.contract: Visible straight LINE/straight LWPOLYLINE segments on a dedicated complete table layer match supplied source segment multiset, including multiplicity and endpoints.
rules.abstain: Incomplete source mapping or unsupported layer members. Split/merged segments fail narrow representation contract; no invented bridge or auto-deletion.

rules.contract: Every non-target modelspace handle and supported resource fingerprint remains unchanged; unapproved additions fail.
rules.abstain: No edit scope, invalid scope or unresolved non-target dependencies. No DWG/GUI conclusion.
